prompt_en: What is the main change announced?
content_en: Good morning. The field exercise will begin at nine thirty instead of eight. All personnel should report to the vehicle park by nine fifteen. The convoy will leave immediately after the final equipment check.

The equipment check is no longer required.

content_en: The water delivery is expected at ten hundred. Fuel should arrive about thirty minutes later. Ammunition resupply will follow after the safety inspection is complete.
content_pl: Dostawa wody jest oczekiwana o dziesiątej zero zero. Paliwo powinno dotrzeć około trzydzieści minut później. Uzupełnienie amunicji nastąpi po zakończeniu kontroli bezpieczeństwa.

options.text_en: The lesson starts later because of the rain.

options.text_en: Take the radio to the workshop and use a spare.
